en.no_clear_signs: No clear signs found (this does not prove it is safe/real)
en.notice: This tool can make mistakes. Use it as a guide, not proof.
en.next_image: Check the original file and where it came from. Do not rely on this result alone.
en.next_text: Do not share an OTP, password or payment. Verify through the official app or a number you already know.
en.failed: A required check did not finish. This does not mean it is safe or real.
en.uncertain: The available checks did not give a clear answer.
en.no_warning: The completed checks found no strong warning. This is not verification.
en.model_warning: One completed check raised a warning. This is not proof of fraud or image origin.
en.quality: Image size or quality limits a reliable answer.
en.conflict: The AI checks disagree. A high reading does not prove that the photo is fake.
en.edit_incomplete: The edit check did not finish or could not give a reliable reading.
en.links_incomplete: Some links could not be checked. Their safety is unknown.
en.link_warning: An included link triggered a warning.
en.SECRET_REQUEST: The message asks you to share an OTP, password or payment PIN.
en.PRIZE_ADVANCE_FEE: The message asks for payment before giving a prize.
en.GUARANTEED_INVESTMENT: The message promises guaranteed or doubled investment returns.
en.edit_scope: Small edits, generative fill, object removal and face swaps can be missed.
en.edit_license: The edit checker is for research and nonprofit use only.
en.link_scope: An address check does not verify the website or its owner. Website checks may be unavailable.
en.language_scope: Some languages and new scam styles are not reliably covered.
en.Technical records below are kept in Engl: Technical records below are kept in English.
en.Where the model looked (not where the ed: Where the model looked (not where the edit is)
en.This view could not be loaded. Try again: This view could not be loaded. Try again.
Your original file is kept unchanged.
en.Highlighted areas are estimates. They ar: Highlighted areas are estimates. They are not proof of an edit.
en.No edited area found (edits can still be: No edited area found (edits can still be missed)
Message and links were checked together. Open the link checks below to see which links could not be checked.
en.Open the TrustNet extension icon to conn: Open the TrustNet extension icon to connect.
en.Click to check this opened message. Noth: Click to check this opened message. Nothing is sent until you click.
en.Check cancelled. No new result is availa: Check cancelled. No new result is available.
en.Only on click, TrustNet contacts this we: Only on click, TrustNet contacts this website. It does not run scripts or submit forms.
en.Website check saved. Missing checks rema: Website check saved. Missing checks remain listed in the full report.
Technical records are kept in English.
en.Check failed. This does not mean it is s: Check failed. This does not mean it is safe.
Sign in again in Connect / settings.
en.Local server is offline. Start TrustNet: Local server is offline. Start TrustNet and retry.
en.This message is too long. Paste a shorte: This message is too long. Paste a shorter section on the website.
en.Open and expand the email, then try agai: Open and expand the email, then try again.
en.Another check is running. Wait or cancel: Another check is running. Wait or cancel it.
The check could not finish. Try again.
en.ai_warning: The completed AI check raised a warning. This is not proof.
en.ai_uncertain: The AI check cannot reliably confirm whether this image is AI-made.
en.edit_warning: The model found a possible edited area. Review the highlighted view.
en.edit_uncertain: No supported edited area was identified. Small edits can still be missed.
en.Choose a view to compare with the origin: Choose a view to compare with the original. Drag the slider to reveal each side.
en.Edited-area check did not finish. No hea: Edited-area check did not finish. No heatmap or mask is available.
en.Heatmap shows the edit model response. M: Heatmap shows the edit model response. Mask shows selected pixels, not confirmed edits.
en.image_no_warning: The completed checks found no strong signs of AI generation or editing. This does not prove the image is real.
en.image_partial_ai: AI warning found. Edit check incomplete.
en.JPEG differences show recompression chan: JPEG differences show recompression changes, not confirmed edits. This is a separate native image window.
en.Brighter colours mean a stronger edit-mo: Brighter colours mean a stronger edit-model response, not a confirmed edit.
en.White pixels mark selected suspected are: White pixels mark selected suspected areas. Black pixels are not selected. This is an estimate, not proof.
en.Bright detail includes natural edges, te: Bright detail includes natural edges, texture and compression. This is not an edit mask.
en.This view shows repeating frequency patt: This view shows repeating frequency patterns. Its positions are frequencies, not locations of edits in the photo.
en.Lines join repeated patterns found by fe: Lines join repeated patterns found by feature matching. Repeated objects can match in real photos too.
en.Shows texture directions and edges. Natu: Shows texture directions and edges. Natural patterns can be bright too. This is not an edited-area mask.
en.These patterns can also occur in unedite: These patterns can also occur in unedited photos.
en.Score interpretation: Detector signal, not the percentage of the image made by AI. The alert also requires adequate quality and model agreement.
en.Authentic rule: Requires verified camera origin and an intact edit history. Not supported by this detector.
en.Likely authentic rule: Disabled until independent real-photo and unseen-edit validation supports it.
en.Uncertain rule: Below the AI alert boundary, conflicting evidence, or an unavailable check. A low score alone does not prove real origin.
en.Likely AI rule: At or above the recorded alert boundary, with adequate quality and primary-model corroboration.
en.AI generated rule: A trusted signed Content Credential explicitly declares AI generation.
en.Grad-CAM on the Vision Transformer. High: Grad-CAM on the Vision Transformer. Highlights what influenced the AI classifier, not edited pixels.
en.Model explanation unavailable for this s: Model explanation unavailable for this scan. Run a new check with explanations enabled.
en.Primary reading note: Raw classifier output, not a probability that the photo is fake.
en.Experimental reading note: Experimental; can wrongly flag real photos. Cannot decide the result alone.
en.verified_ai_origin: Verified file credentials declare AI generation.
en.Verified signed record declares AI gener: Verified signed record declares AI generation
en.File declares AI generation; signer coul: File declares AI generation; signer could not be verified
en.verified_ai_edit: Verified file credentials declare AI editing. This does not identify the edited pixels.
en.Verified AI editing record: Verified file credentials declare AI editing
en.Editing check incomplete: Editing check incomplete. No edited-area mask is available.
Drag to compare with the original.
en.unverified_ai_origin: The file declares AI use, but its signing identity could not be verified.

hi.no_clear_signs: Koi saaf sanket nahi mila (isse safe ya real hona prove nahi hota)
hi.notice: Yeh tool galti kar sakta hai. Ise madad ke liye use karein, saboot na maanein.
hi.next_image: Original file aur uske source ko check karein. Sirf is result par faisla na lein.
hi.next_text: OTP, password ya paise na dein. Official app ya jaane pehchaane number se confirm karein.
hi.failed: Zaroori check poora nahi hua. Iska matlab safe ya real nahi hai.
hi.uncertain: Mile hue checks se saaf jawab nahi mila.
hi.no_warning: Poore hue checks mein strong warning nahi mili. Yeh verification nahi hai.
hi.model_warning: Ek poore hue check mein warning mili. Yeh fraud ya image ke source ka saboot nahi hai.
hi.quality: Image ka size ya quality bharosemand jawab ko limit karti hai.
hi.conflict: AI checks aapas mein sehmat nahi hain. Zyada reading se photo fake prove nahi hoti.
hi.edit_incomplete: Editing ka check poora nahi hua ya bharosemand jawab nahi mila.
hi.links_incomplete: Kuch links check nahi hue. Unka safe hona pata nahi hai.
hi.link_warning: Message ke ek link par warning mili.
hi.SECRET_REQUEST: Message aapse OTP, password ya payment PIN maang raha hai.
hi.PRIZE_ADVANCE_FEE: Message inaam dene se pehle paise maang raha hai.
hi.GUARANTEED_INVESTMENT: Message investment par guaranteed ya double return ka vaada karta hai.
hi.edit_scope: Chhote edits, generative fill, object removal aur face swap miss ho sakte hain.
hi.edit_license: Edit checker sirf research aur nonprofit use ke liye hai.
hi.link_scope: Address check website ya uske malik ko verify nahi karta. Website checks unavailable ho sakte hain.
hi.language_scope: Kuch bhashayein aur naye scam bharosemand tarah se cover nahi hote.
hi.Technical records below are kept in Engl: Neeche technical records English mein hain.

hi.ai_warning: AI check mein warning mili. Yeh saboot nahi hai.

hi.Choose a view to compare with the origin: Original se compare karne ke liye view chunein. Dono taraf dekhne ke liye slider khisakayein.

hi.JPEG differences show recompression chan: JPEG ka farak recompression dikhata hai, pakke edits nahi. Yeh image ka alag native window hai.

hi.White pixels mark selected suspected are: Safed pixels shak wale selected area hain. Kale pixels selected nahi hain. Yeh andaza hai, saboot nahi.

hi.This view shows repeating frequency patt: Yeh frequency patterns hain. Inki jagah photo mein edit ki jagah nahi batati.
hi.Lines join repeated patterns found by fe: Lines feature matching se mile dohraye patterns jodti hain. Asli photos mein bhi cheezein repeat ho sakti hain.
hi.Shows texture directions and edges. Natu: Ismein texture aur kinare dikhte hain. Asli photo ke patterns bhi chamak sakte hain. Yeh edited area ka mask nahi hai.
hi.These patterns can also occur in unedite: Yeh patterns bina edit wali photos mein bhi ho sakte hain.
hi.Score interpretation: Detector signal, not the percentage of the image made by AI. The alert also requires adequate quality and model agreement.

hi.Likely authentic rule: Disabled until independent real-photo and unseen-edit validation supports it.
hi.Uncertain rule: Below the AI alert boundary, conflicting evidence, or an unavailable check. A low score alone does not prove real origin.

hi.Primary reading note: Yeh model ka raw output hai, photo fake hone ki probability nahi.
hi.Experimental reading note: Experimental hai; real photos ko galat flag kar sakta hai. Akela verdict nahi de sakta.
